import pytest
from subject import is_valid_onex_name


def test_empty_string_returns_false():
    assert is_valid_onex_name("") is False
    assert is_valid_onex_name("", lowercase_only=True) is False


def test_valid_general_names():
    valid = [
        "abc",
        "ABC",
        "AbC",
        "123",
        "a1b2c3",
        "_",
        "__",
        "_abc_",
        "abc_123",
        "ABC_123",
        "a_b_c",
    ]
    for name in valid:
        assert is_valid_onex_name(name) is True, f"Expected {name!r} to be valid"


def test_valid_lowercase_only_names():
    valid = [
        "abc",
        "123",
        "a1b2c3",
        "_",
        "__",
        "_abc_",
        "abc_123",
        "a_b_c",
    ]

        assert is_valid_onex_name(name, lowercase_only=True) is True, f"Expected {name!r} to be valid (lowercase_only)"

def test_mixed_case_rejected_when_lowercase_only():
    assert is_valid_onex_name("Abc", lowercase_only=True) is False
    assert is_valid_onex_name("aBc", lowercase_only=True) is False
    assert is_valid_onex_name("abC", lowercase_only=True) is False
    assert is_valid_onex_name("ABC", lowercase_only=True) is False


def test_mixed_case_accepted_when_not_lowercase_only():

    assert is_valid_onex_name("abC") is True
    assert is_valid_onex_name("ABC") is True
